comment: Table 8 lnict: HIC (0.094)*** SE 0.032, LIC 0.158*** SE 0.028; Observations 628 / 224 (col 4, col 12). Table outcome labelled economic growth; constant ~8 suggests ln GDP level. Poorer larger OK.
